    Are Dan Hurley and Bobby Hurley related?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Dan Hurley and Bobby Hurley are brothers. They are prominent figures in American basketball, born to Basketball Hall of Fame coach Bob Hurley. Bobby is the older brother and a former star player at Duke, while Dan is the head coach at UConn. They have both coached at the collegiate level, with Bobby previously coaching at Arizona State. 
    • Relationship: They are brothers, with Bobby being the elder.
    • Family Background: They are sons of legendary Jersey City coach Bob Hurley.
    • Coaching Careers: Dan Hurley is the head coach at UConn (leading them to back-to-back NCAA titles), while Bobby Hurley is a former head coach at Arizona State.
    • History:
      In 2010, Bobby served as an assistant coach for Dan at Wagner College.
